description.brief: Enjoy the chaos of a completely broken game, with custom settings!
description.full: You in for chaos? This mod attempts to screw up as many aspects of the code as possible to create a totally broken game.

description.brief: GO TRICK OR TREATING!!!!
description.full:
After an undefined amount of time after the events of Robot 64, Dr. Smarchibliss has brought back Beebo for one very important reason:
GO TRICK OR TREATING!!!!

description.brief: Experience Robot 64 just like the old days!
description.full:
Experience Robot 64 in another view! You should get really RETRO this time! with the most accurate Nintendo 64 style you have ever seen in your life!!!!!

This is a mod that recreated Robot 64 in actual Nintendo 64 style! All credits to zKevin!

description.brief: BETA DEMO 2.5 IS HERE!
description.full: Many years before the events of Robot Sixty-Four, back when the sun was Jolly and Happy, and when people were somewhat normal, a scientist that went by the name of Professor PalChibliss made a Robot called Treble. Unfortunately, Treble went rogue and started causing trouble across Papatopia. So, Prof. Pal made Bass, a similar yet more stable robot. Bass was tasked to track down and deactivate Treble.

description.brief: Randomizes many aspects of the game for a new experience!
description.full: My own spin on a randomizer game, here you can make many aspects of the game random such as warps, skins, music, sound effects and more!

description.brief: A mod where you can play tag with many other players on unique maps with features like modifiers!
description.full:
A mod that lets you play tag with other Beebos!
Recommended that you play on pc and have good wifi for the best experience.
There are many maps and a custom lobby!

description.brief: A mod that reimagines the Candy Aquarium and New Neocity with great design!
description.full: Robot 64 Revise is a new mod that aims to reimagine what Candy Aquarium and New Neocity could have been with great designs and features!

description.brief: Play spleef... with the Robot 64 engine!
description.full:
Play spleef with the Robot 64 engine!
Features three abilities and a few modifiers.
Credits to TheCoolChocolate for inspiration & the original Robot 64 Spleef and zKevin for the Robot 64 engine

description.brief: This is a discontinued project which aimed to be a full fledged sequel to the original game.
description.full: This is a discontinued project which aimed to be a full fledged sequel to the original game, the movement is bastly different and the levels are entirely new. Just beware that this game can be quite difficult for no reason and hard to understand at times, the levels can be a bit ugly and the dialogue is HORRIBLE.

description.brief: Dr. Smar is testing Beebo
description.full: Dr. Smar is testing Beebo to see if he's strong enough for the real world. Finish the test and defeat Dr. Smar!

description.brief: An open-world-like Robot 64 mod.
description.full:
Dr. Smar is hosting a party and all of Papatopia is invited! But who will get all the snacks? That's right, Beebo!
Explore 14 worlds*, collect ice cream, customize Beebo, and most importantly, have fun!
*only one world currently exists, sorry!

description.brief: A revival of the good ol' PlayDB!
description.full: PlayDB [Revival] is a revival of the mod PlayDB by EmK530. It is an attempt to allow people to relive what they used to do and acts as a way for people to view and play their old levels. This mod includes MAKE and PLAY, so you can also create brand new levels.

description.brief: A mod where you race other players from the start of a level to a certain ice cream!
description.full: Robot 64 Racing is a Robot 64 Mod where you race with others to get the ice cream first. You can get custom hats, skins, and dots! You can also submit new maps, lobbies, hats, skins, or dots for me to add to the game as well!

description.brief: A modzone with beestone tools and an improved level creator!
description.full: A useful set of tools created for players who experiment with beestone! Includes level creator improvements and a custom select tool!

description.brief: An easy way to see what the game is doing and test different scenarios.
description.full: A simple modzone with an overlay that shows the values of important variables and also lets you enable different settings while playing.

description.brief: A testing place for a manhunt gamemode within Robot 64!
description.full: A mod with code to allow a manhunt experience in Robot 64 with hunter and runner teams, spectating and many more commands. Check the game's description page for them all!

description.brief: Robot 64 with various hacks appliable to assist in glitch-hunting.
description.full: The first mod zone by Poké, containing useful settings like hitbox/radius visibility, walk through walls, speed, invincibility and many more things.

description.brief: NEW Robot 64 Tycoon. Build your empire! Collect gears and get that sweet sweet candy. TYCOON TYCOON NEW
description.full:
WELCOME TO THE BRAND SPANKIN' NEW Robot 64 Tycoon! BUILD UP YOUR TYCOON EMPIRE WHILE GATHERING CANDY AND GEARS ALONG THE WAY! SHOW OFF TO YOUR FOES WITH YOUR EPIC GEARS SUCH AS: Grappling Hook, Gravity Coil AND SO MUCH MORE!

Tags (ignore):
TYCOON TYCOON TYCOON TYCOON NEW NEW SUPERHERO

description.brief: A fanmade sequel to Robot 64 with a new story and 6 new worlds to play!
description.full: Robot SixtySeven is a fan made sequel to Robot SixtyFour, where there's a giant lifeform in outer space! You'll need to explore six new levels to collect more ice cream and stop it before it destroys the world!

description.brief: Delve deeper and deeper into Beebo's unconscious mind.
description.full: This mod has a heavy emphasis on exploration! - Beebo is in the middle of booting up and he'll tasked with something he may or may not be prepared for! It is your duty to help him gain knowledge, as the real adventure has not begun just yet!

description.brief: Robot 64 with a more detailed timer and some QoL changes for the BTT.
description.full: Second installment of Poké's mod zones, this one contains settings catered towards BTT speedrunners of the game.

description.brief: You ever wanted to collaborate on building a level with your friends? Now you can with build2gether!
description.full: You ever wanted to collaborate on building a level with your friends? Now you can with build2gether!

description.brief: Robot 64 edited to be a true test of your knowledge and skill!
description.full: You in for hell? Kaizo Robot 64 is a difficult version of Robot 64 designed to force the usage of many glitches that exist to complete the game. Along with many other challenges. You think you're a Robot 64 professional? Visit this and think again.

description.brief: 100 floors of glitchless challenges for advanced casual players!
description.full:
work in progress but currently planned to be 100 glitchless floors of pain and misery and death and yippee (with plenty of secrets!!)
all glitches are allowed including translation feedback/rmlaunches or whatever because idk how to patch them and they make the game more fun for more experienced players
if you see me in-game please give me feedback on how to improve it, this game is in very early testing and i need all the help i can get on making it better
a lot like robot 64 supreme homerun by bigheadbozo (which is also inspired by kaizo robot 64 final homerun)

description.brief: A mod where you can test your robot 64 knowledge and experience many weird events!
description.full: Eyy there bucko!! It's me! Rusty! Recognize me? I made a trivia show where ya can see how well ya really know robot 64!! You MAY encounter SOME odd events happening but that's no biggie!!

description.brief: The hardest of them all. This kaizo pushes precise platforming to its limits. (minimal glitches needed)
description.full:
A Kaizo Robot 64 fangame that is meant to push the skill cap movement tech wise instead of glitch wise.
Gameplay enjoyment is also a huge priority and has had much care put into it, expect it to be good.

description.brief: A challenging mod consisting of 100 floors of parkour, puzzles, and pain!
description.full: This mod is heavily inspired by Kaizo Robot 64's Final Homerun, but it's designed to be possible, and fair towards casual players! That doesn't mean it's still not difficult though. Expect tight jumps, long gaps, strange movement, and more!

description.brief: Just your regular kaizo, with a 2 Dimensional twist.
description.full:
This mod is inspired by many of the Super Mario World kaizo mods, being focused on precise and fun platforming. contains custom mechanics, without changing the Robot 64 movement.
Go through Stages that dont require any glitches, just skilled platforming. These stages may be 2 Dimensional, but the gameplay surely does look sick as hell.

description.brief: A mod about seeing how long you can last in an infinite gameplay loop of randomly generated levels!
description.full: Endless Robot 64 is a mod about seeing how long you can last in an infinite gameplay loop of randomly generated Robot 64 levels!

description.brief: A new, fun adventure with a more organic beebo!
description.full:
After destroying the sun, Dr Smar decides to test his building skills. He makes a new Beebo, but this time, he's more organic. That's right, he can bleed just like you and me!

However, this comes with some drawback, you can now break your legs from falling too far, so be careful! Also, since you're kind of like a real person now, everyone hates you too! People will constantly try to hinder with your adventure to collect ice creams for Dr Smar! Expect more boss fights from characters you'd never expect, such as Sheldon Sign, Sheldon Sign, and Sheldon Sign! Speaking of Dr Smar, where is he?

description.brief: Have fun with many settings and try different game modes in this mod zone!
description.full: This mod zone has WAY too many cool things to describe here, a custom settings menu with useful settings and special game modes you can play using "New Game+" such as everything being upside down!

description.brief: Continuation of Kaizo Robot 64's "Final Homerun"
description.full: Continuation of Kaizo Robot 64's infamous gauntlet, Final Homerun. This game is one of the hardest fangames out there.

description.brief: Play as Smirkie, on a quest to stop the corrupt director Cool Guy.
description.full: Smirk 64 is a vibrant 3D platformer where you play as Smirkie, on a quest to stop Cool Guy. Journey through 9 vast worlds, collecting Smirks to unlock new levels.

description.brief: Robot 64 with a new Frontflip move, some graphical changes, and new levels.
description.full: Robot 64 with a new Frontflip move, some graphical changes, and new levels.

description.brief: Play as nimbu, exploring weird, strange and wacky worlds to collect gumdrops and destroy the moon!
description.full:
Nimbus is a 3D Platformer Game! This uses the official robot 64 engine release by zkevin himself!
You play as a robot named nimbu! Explore weird, strange and wacky worlds! Collect all of the gumdrops to destroy the moon! 
Do you have what it takes?

mods.name: hard robot 64 2: the ultimate kazio adventure

description.brief: THIS GAME IS NOT FOR THE WEAK
description.full: seventeen trillion years after hard robot 64, dr. smar is revived and creates a new beebo with literally no moveset upgrades. Beebo is tasked with a mission of collecting ice cream for no reason other than to be cool.

description.brief: Complete levels, get ice creams.
description.full: In this Robot 64 mod, you have to beat levels to get ice creams. And what's the purpose of getting ice creams, you may or may not ask? To unlock even more levels.. so you can get even more ice creams!

description.brief: A now abandoned fan project, the old version of aperson's kaizo mod.
description.full: A now abandoned fan project, the old version of aperson's kaizo mod.

description.brief: A mod zone for testing floor warps, with features to simulate dex lag and more.
description.full: A mod zone for testing floor warps, with features to simulate dex lag and more.

description.brief: Clean Knoddy's Resort with your friends!
description.full: Knoddy has made 8 clones of himself and is using them as janitors. Take control of them with your friends and clean up the resort, collect badges and cosmetics, and play around with grabbable objects!

description.brief: A mod inspired by Odyssey with a new moveset, powerups, new and modified levels, and more to come!
description.full: Super Robot Odyssey is a mod inspired by Odyssey with new powerups, a new moveset and some modified levels for the movement; Hopefully eventually all new levels and the hub won't use anything from zKevin.

description.brief: Want something harder? Try the most vile option.
description.full: Want something harder? Try the most vile option.

description.brief: Save a paralel papatopia from a mysterious being.
description.full: NOTE: This mod is currently in hiatus. In an entirely separate universe from Robot 64, when the sun was smiling, there was a danger that may destroy Papatopia, some weird meteors have fallen all around the world, strange! But then, a young scientist named Eman has been noticing the chaos, so he biult a robot named Uigi, they will collect lightbulbs to try and stop this madness.

description.brief: Robot 64 with two character spheres, leading to interesting buggy physics!
description.full: A mod where you can control two characters by warping your POV between them by middle clicking your mouse.

mods.name: mod zone 4? how? why? since when?

description.brief: Robot 64 with the enemy table viewable for quantum physics.
description.full: This is a technical mod zone which contains information about the enemy table on your screen.

description.brief: Robot 64 with all entrances randomized!
description.full: This mod zone is a randomizer which switches up many parts of the game, this also contains different variations like mod zone 3.5 and 3.75 with the higher numbers being more random.
